meta_title: JG Exterior Cleaning | Window Cleaner Newcastle
meta_description: JG Exterior Cleaning in Newcastle offers professional window cleaning for homes and businesses. Streak-free results, fully insured. Get a free quote today.
hero_subhead: Crystal-clear windows in Newcastle, inside and out. Same-week appointments and no hidden costs.
services_heading: Professional Window Cleaning Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From domestic terraces to commercial office blocks, we clean every window type to leave your property spotless.

services.title: Domestic Window Cleaning
services.desc: Sparkling clean windows for your home, inside and out. Water-fed pole and traditional methods ensure a streak-free finish every time.

services.title: Commercial & Office Cleaning
services.desc: Keep your business premises looking professional. Regular cleaning schedules to suit your office hours, with minimal disruption.

services.title: High-Rise & Difficult Access
services.desc: Safely clean windows on multi-storey buildings and hard-to-reach areas using specialist equipment and trained technicians.

services.title: Conservatory & Roof Cleaning
services.desc: Remove algae, moss, and dirt from conservatory glass and roof panels. Restores clarity and extends the life of your glazing.

services.title: Gutter & Fascia Cleaning
services.desc: Clear blocked gutters and fascias whilst we're there. Stops water damage and keeps your property maintained year-round.

services.title: After-Build Cleaning
services.desc: Remove construction dust and debris from new builds and renovations. Get your property camera-ready in one visit.

about_pullquote: We do the job right, every time. That's how we've built trust in Newcastle.
about_para_1: JG Exterior Cleaning has been serving Newcastle homes and businesses for over 8 years. We started because we saw too many window cleaners cutting corners and leaving streaks. Now we've cleaned thousands of properties across the city, from Victorian terraces to modern office blocks, using industry-standard equipment and proven techniques.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we turn up on time, quote fairly, and deliver exactly what we promise. We're fully insured, carry all our own equipment, and treat your property with respect. Many of our clients have us back year after year — that's the real measure of a job well done.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: JG cleaned my windows before I sold my house and they looked immaculate. The lad was polite, efficient, and didn't leave mess everywhere. Highly recommend — saved me a fortune on the valuation.

reviews.text: Been using them for three years now. Reliable, fair price, and they always ring ahead to confirm. Windows are spotless every time. Can't fault them.
